CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.fn_union_pnl_cash_outcome_accepted(o union_pnl_cash_outcomes)
 RETURNS boolean
 LANGUAGE sql
 STABLE
 SET search_path TO 'public', 'pg_temp'
AS $function$
 SELECT o.evidence->'all_players_included' IS NOT DISTINCT FROM 'true'::jsonb
  AND o.evidence->'game_scope' IS NOT DISTINCT FROM o.game_scope
  AND ((o.evidence->>'status' IS NOT DISTINCT FROM 'ready' AND o.evidence->'basis_certified' IS NOT DISTINCT FROM 'true'::jsonb)
   OR EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM public.union_pnl_cash_outcome_resolutions r WHERE r.table_id=o.table_id AND r.hand_number=o.hand_number
    AND r.hand_id=o.hand_id AND r.outcome_payload_hash=o.payload_hash AND r.outcome_evidence_md5=md5(o.evidence::text))
   OR EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM public.union_pnl_cash_outcomes actual
     WHERE actual.table_id=o.table_id AND actual.hand_number=o.hand_number
      AND to_jsonb(actual) IS NOT DISTINCT FROM to_jsonb(o)
      AND smarter_private.posthand_escrow_certified_evidence(o.table_id,o.hand_number) IS NOT NULL))
$function$

CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.fn_union_pnl_cash_outcome_link(o union_pnl_cash_outcomes)
 RETURNS SETOF union_pnl_cash_outcome_link_resolutions
 LANGUAGE sql
 STABLE
 SET search_path TO 'public', 'pg_temp'
AS $function$
 SELECT r.* FROM public.union_pnl_cash_outcome_link_resolutions r
 WHERE r.table_id=o.table_id AND r.hand_number=o.hand_number AND r.hand_id=o.hand_id
  AND r.outcome_payload_hash=o.payload_hash AND r.outcome_evidence_md5=md5(o.evidence::text) AND r.proof_md5=md5(r.proof::text)
$function$

CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.fn_union_pnl_linked_cash_outcomes(p_union_id uuid, p_start timestamp with time zone, p_end timestamp with time zone)
 RETURNS TABLE(table_id uuid, hand_number bigint, game_scope jsonb, evidence jsonb)
 LANGUAGE sql
 STABLE
 SET search_path TO 'public', 'pg_temp'
AS $function$
 SELECT r.table_id,r.hand_number,r.game_scope,r.evidence
 FROM public.union_pnl_cash_outcome_link_resolutions r
 JOIN public.union_pnl_cash_outcomes o ON o.table_id=r.table_id AND o.hand_number=r.hand_number
 WHERE r.game_scope->>'game_union_id'=p_union_id::text AND o.recognized_at>=p_start AND o.recognized_at<p_end
  AND r.hand_id=o.hand_id AND r.outcome_payload_hash=o.payload_hash AND r.outcome_evidence_md5=md5(o.evidence::text)
  AND r.proof_md5=md5(r.proof::text)
$function$

CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.fn_union_pnl_projection_ready(p_projection text)
 RETURNS boolean
 LANGUAGE sql
 STABLE SECURITY DEFINER
 SET search_path TO 'public', 'pg_temp'
AS $function$
 SELECT COALESCE((SELECT b.completed_at IS NOT NULL FROM public.union_pnl_projection_build b WHERE b.projection=p_projection),false)
$function$

definitions.signature: fn_union_pnl_week_shaped_hands(uuid,timestamp with time zone,timestamp with time zone,boolean)
definitions.full_definition:
CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.fn_union_pnl_week_shaped_hands(p_union_id uuid, p_start timestamp with time zone, p_end timestamp with time zone, p_projected boolean)
 RETURNS SETOF union_pnl_cash_outcomes
 LANGUAGE plpgsql
 STABLE SECURITY DEFINER
 SET search_path TO 'public', 'pg_temp'
AS $function$
BEGIN
 IF p_projected THEN
  RETURN QUERY WITH candidates AS MATERIALIZED (
   SELECT q.* FROM public.union_pnl_cash_outcomes q
   WHERE q.game_scope->>'game_union_id'=p_union_id::text AND q.recognized_at>=p_start AND q.recognized_at<p_end
    AND (q.evidence->>'status' IS DISTINCT FROM 'ready' OR q.evidence->'basis_certified' IS DISTINCT FROM 'true'::jsonb
     OR q.evidence->'all_players_included' IS DISTINCT FROM 'true'::jsonb OR q.evidence->'game_scope' IS DISTINCT FROM q.game_scope)
  ) SELECT o.* FROM candidates o
   WHERE (SELECT CASE WHEN h.game_union_id=p_union_id::text AND h.recognized_at>=p_start AND h.recognized_at<p_end
    THEN h.shaped ELSE false END FROM public.union_pnl_cash_outcome_touches h
    WHERE h.table_id=o.table_id AND h.hand_number=o.hand_number) IS TRUE;
 ELSE
  RETURN QUERY SELECT o.* FROM public.union_pnl_cash_outcomes o WHERE o.game_scope->>'game_union_id'=p_union_id::text AND o.recognized_at>=p_start AND o.recognized_at<p_end
   AND (o.evidence->>'status' IS DISTINCT FROM 'ready' OR o.evidence->'basis_certified' IS DISTINCT FROM 'true'::jsonb
    OR o.evidence->'all_players_included' IS DISTINCT FROM 'true'::jsonb OR o.evidence->'game_scope' IS DISTINCT FROM o.game_scope);
 END IF;
END $function$
